graphicsApi.notes: Metal supports compute shaders, so the URP GPU Resident Drawer and Forward+/Deferred+ rendering paths are supported on iOS. VisionOS (Apple's spatial computing platform) is a separate profile — GPU Resident Drawer is explicitly unsupported there even though it shares the Metal API.

textureCompression.notes: Unity 6.4 removed PVRTC -- it can no longer be targeted on import. Use ASTC (preferred) or ETC. Never emit a PVRTC import setting for an iOS target on the Unity 6.4 baseline; treat an existing one as a migration item.

unity64Notes.runtimeLibraryPath: On Unity 6.4 the Apple runtime libraries ship as a static framework at XcodeFolder/Frameworks/UnityRuntime.framework/UnityRuntime, used for both device and simulator. Any Xcode post-processing script that hard-codes the old Libraries/ path breaks.
